notes: REF-BM-02: no remote metadata fetch; title defaults to URL, no description/favicon/preview collection. REF-BM-03: title/description are editable before and after save, but nothing is auto-collected. REF-BM-04: url/title/description/tags editable, but no note field. REF-BM-06: POST always creates a new bookmark; no duplicate-URL detection or convergence to editing. REF-BM-07: list shows title/description/tags but no favicon. REF-BM-10: tags are a plain comma-separated text input with no autocomplete/datalist. REF-BM-12: substring search covers title/description/url (and tags) but there is no note field. REF-BM-14: no #tag search syntax. REF-BM-15: no AND/OR/NOT or parenthesised groups. REF-BM-16: no quoted-phrase exact match. REF-BM-17/18/19: no unread flag, unread view, or mark-as-read. REF-BM-20/21: no multi-select or bulk actions. REF-BM-22: no sort control; list is fixed newest-first. REF-BM-23: no markdown note. REF-BM-24/25: no local/PDF or Internet Archive snapshots. REF-BM-26/27/28: no archive flag, view, or archive-vs-delete distinction (only permanent delete). REF-BM-29: no bundles. REF-BM-30/31: no Netscape HTML import/export. REF-BM-32: no display/personal settings.
